text: Entry 1517 renames test_markRead/test_junk to testMarkRead/testJunk and adds testArchive/testDelete. Those names remain in the current navigation file, whose browser_mailContext_navigation.js filename retains its existing underscores. Proposed naming rule for new tasks in this file: match the current testVerb style and name the action. The adjacent message-pane regression file uses snake_case task names, so this is a local recommendation rather than a project-wide rename mandate. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Navigation menu tasks now use descriptive lowerCamelCase names
